messages:
nate: Quick update from the regional continuous-batcher sweep for the new-3b-q8 bring-up. Ran paired benches across us-east (h100), eu-west (a100), and apac (h100g).

marta: Nice. Main axis we care about? latency p99, throughput at 95% load, and quality drift after q8.

cheng: I focused on scheduler knobs: batch_window_ms, max_batch_tokens, and priority_decay. Baseline: batch_window_ms=20, max_batch_tokens=2048, priority_decay=0.6.

ravi: Observations:
- us-east (h100) throughput stable, p95 ~ 85ms, p99 ~ 270ms.
- eu-west (a100) slightly higher p99 ~ 320ms under same config.
- apac (h100g) shows microburst tail at p99 ~ 420ms when mixed short+long queries.

nate: Key thing: when we increased max_batch_tokens -> 4096, p99 *improved* for long queries on h100 but tail got worse on a100. Suspect kernel choice fallback for long kv-cache seqs.

cheng: Reproduced locally. Kernel selector log shows fallback to generic_matmul at > 3k tokens on a100 image. Paste of the log:
```
[2026-03-18 14:03:12] kernel-selector: model=new-3b arch=rwkv seq=4096 hw=a100 selected=generic_matmul (perf=0.67)
[2026-03-18 14:03:12] kernel-selector: model=new-3b arch=rwkv seq=2048 hw=h100 selected=optimized_attention (perf=0.91)
```

marta: That explains the regional diff. Can we try lowering batch_window_ms to 12ms and enable hybrid-tiling on a100 to force optimized path?

ravi: Ran that config on eu-west: batch_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=4096, hybrid_tiling=true. Results: p95 ~ 95ms, p99 ~ 280ms (so ~12% improvement vs baseline). Throughput drops ~4% at high concurrency.

nate: Also did a quick quantization quality check (q8) vs float16 on a prompt corpus of 2k evals: avg logprob delta ~ -0.003, rouge-L down 0.6 points on summaries. Not ideal but within our regression threshold for now.

cheng: Did you run the eval with cache warmup? q8 tends to jump on cold KV caching.

nate: Yes -- warmup 50 samples per model. Metrics attached inline:
```
model,new,q,rougeL,avg_ll
new-3b,float16,0,42.7,-1.23
new-3b,q8,0,-41.1,-1.233
```

marta: Slightly odd CSV format but ok. Looks like small quality hit. We should flag for a focused eval suite (long-form summarization) before enabling q8 for Dedicated customers.

ravi: Scheduler fairness note: with priority_decay=0.6 low-priority cohorts were getting starved at >95% load on apac. Tried priority_decay=0.85 -> reduces starvation but increases median latency by ~6ms. Tradeoff looks acceptable.

cheng: Action items:
1) infra: push hybrid_tiling toggle to eu-west staging and run 24h soak (assigned: nate).
2) ml: run long-form rouge eval on 10k prompts q8 vs float16 (assigned: marta).
3) runtime: add kernel-selector telemetry for seq_len buckets >2k (assigned: cheng).

nate: Starting eu-west soak now. Command used:
```bash
./bench --model new-3b --quant q8 --region eu-west --gpu a100 --batch-window 12 --max-batch-tokens 4096 --hybrid-tiling --duration 24h
```

ci-bot: Build 2026.03.18-rc deployed to eu-west-staging (job id: 8812). Logs: https://ci.redwood/8812

marta: Thanks — will kick off the long-form eval and report by EOD tomorrow. If quality drop >1.5 rouge-L we'll block q8 rollout for Dedicated.

ravi: I'll monitor apac tail during the soak and post any regression. If tail persists we may need a region-specific kernel-override for sequences >3k.

nate: Cool. Will post a short follow-up with soak numbers and kernel-selector traces once 6h into the run. :thumbsup:
